verdict.rationale: Statsig's own docs say its CLI can be integrated into CI/CD pipelines to automate management of Feature Gates and Experiments. A versioned Console API with a public OpenAPI spec performs console actions without the web UI, and an HTTP API works without an SDK, so headless and CI automation are directly supported. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, documented CI-specific details such as non-interactive auth and example pipeline configs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can integrate the CLI into CI/CD pipelines to automate the management of Feature Gates and Experiments.
The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
The Statsig CLI is a command-line interface that helps manage Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs within the Statsig platform.
